c74object.name: ambitap.panbin~
c74object.digest: Pan a mono source directly to binaural stereo with a per-source HRTF (built-in MIT KEMAR) at an arbitrary azimuth/elevation — no ambisonic bus, no order-limited blur
c74object.description: Pan a mono source directly to binaural stereo with a per-source HRTF (built-in MIT KEMAR) at an arbitrary azimuth/elevation — no ambisonic bus, no order-limited blur. Direction changes crossfade click-free.

attribute.name: azimuth
attribute.description: Source azimuth in radians. 0 = front, pi/2 = left, pi = behind.

attribute.name: elevation
attribute.description: Source elevation in radians. 0 = horizon, pi/2 = zenith.
